## Description {#details}

<p>A recipe to wrap on original IR instruction not to be modified during execution, execept for PHIs.</p>


<p>For PHIs, a single <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/vpvalue">VPValue</a> operand is allowed, and it is used to add a new incoming value for the single predecessor VPBB. Expect PHIs, VPIRInstructions cannot have any operands.</p>


<p>Definition at line 1375 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/lib/lib/transforms/lib/transforms/vectorize/vplan-h">VPlan.h</a>.</p>
